candidate.message: Confirmed candidate: admission scans XML policy only when archive entry lower.ends_with('.xml'|'.rels') (src/admission.rs:534-545), special-cases only main_part missing extension (558-569). Renderer loads arbitrary header/footer relationship target without extension constraint (src/convert/mod.rs:20762-20779), passes directly to unbounded recursive Dom::parse_xdocument at 20794-20795; parse_element recursively invokes itself at src/xmllinq/parse.rs:660-662. An attacker can target word/header.bin and put deeply nested well-formed XML there, bypass max_xml_depth=256 and crash converter host via stack exhaustion. Investigating all entrypoint controls before final.
